new_slots.name: Senate poll support
new_slots.sentence: A Fox News statewide survey of Iowa likely voters finds Democrat Josh Turek with a two-point edge over Republican Ashley Hinson, 49% to 47%, well within the margin of error.

new_slots.name: Governor poll support
new_slots.sentence: In the Iowa governor’s contest, Democrat Rob Sand outperforms Republican Zach Lahn among likely voters by 53-44%.

new_slots.name: Poll sample size
new_slots.sentence: this Fox News Poll includes interviews with a sample of 1,204 Iowa registered voters randomly selected from a statewide voter file.

new_slots.name: Trump approval
new_slots.sentence: Today, that’s how many Iowa voters disapprove of his job performance as president (57%), while far fewer, 42%, approve.

new_slots.name: Hinson favorability
new_slots.sentence: While 42% view her positively, 50% have an unfavorable view, including nearly 4 in 10 who are "strongly" unfavorable.

new_slots.name: Turek favorability
new_slots.sentence: In contrast, Turek’s ratings are net positive: 48% favorable to 40% unfavorable (24% "strongly" unfavorable).

new_slots.name: registered voter support Turek
new_slots.sentence: Among registered voters, Turek is ahead by 4 points, 50% to 46%.

new_slots.name: Democratic support for Turek
new_slots.sentence: Democrats are more unified behind state representative Turek (96%) than Republicans are of current Congresswoman Hinson (87%).

new_slots.name: Senate control preference Democrat
new_slots.sentence: Iowa voters are split on control of the Senate: 49% prefer Democratic control and 48% favor Republican.

new_slots.name: Turek lead among women
new_slots.sentence: Turek is preferred by 11 points among women, 16 points in the suburbs, 17 points among voters with a college degree, and 32 points among independents.

new_slots.name: Hinson lead among men
new_slots.sentence: Hinson is up by 7 points among men, 6 points among those without a college degree, 14 points among rural voters, and 41 points among White evangelical Christians.

new_slots.name: financial distress 2024
new_slots.sentence: In the 2024 Fox News Voter Analysis, 3 in 10 Iowans described their families as falling behind financially.

new_slots.name: financial distress 2026
new_slots.sentence: That share has risen to 4 in 10 today, and they back Turek by a 38-point margin.

new_slots.name: financial steady rate
new_slots.sentence: Meanwhile, those holding steady (45%) and getting ahead (13%) favor Hinson (by 14 and 53 points respectively).

new_slots.name: cost of living importance
new_slots.sentence: In addition, 6 in 10 say the cost of living will be extremely important to their Senate vote decision.

new_slots.name: Trump importance Senate vote
new_slots.sentence: That outpaces other top issues, like President Donald Trump (43% extremely), immigration (39% extremely), and AI technology (27% extremely).

new_slots.name: Trump 2024 Iowa vote share
new_slots.sentence: Trump won Iowa with nearly 56% of the vote in 2024.
